## October17 disposition

**Parked draft — acceptance incomplete.** Retained as a parked draft. Its activation files and historical source/lease assumptions differ from current main; no fresh physical authority or merge is granted by this audit.

[Complete current triage](https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/blob/codex/verdify-live-replan-20261017/planning/reviews/2026-10-17/PRS-AND-WORK.md). Branches and failed evidence are retained; source closure is not runtime/physical acceptance.
<!-- verdify-pr-triage-20261017:end -->

## Purpose
Stage the one-shot #641 Gate P direct-proof activation for experiment `45039c86-c1d9-52f6-a0a9-d94a17bc4b14`. This PR is intentionally **draft and not mergeable yet**. It makes the canonical production overlay render the direct-proof component, binds the exact existing Gate R experiment/config, enables only the singleton ingestor's experiment component, and unsuspends the PostSync proof Job. Policy vector mode remains `off`. No physical check is a gate.

## Final binding before merge
Replace all `REPLACE_AFTER_FINAL_BUILD_*` and the invalid Job image with the final source SHA, immutable orchestrator image digest, and a fresh bounded UTC window (at least 45 minutes remaining at Job start; source permits at most 12 hours). Rebase onto the actual production source revision and review the whole prod render/diff. These placeholders deliberately prevent an accidental runnable activation.

The authorizing references record Jason's existing “Just run it,” “I can check whenever,” and “Do not include physical checks as a gate” directions. No new user permission is required for those choices.

## Production ordering (root operator owns execution)
1. Merge and promote the release containing migrations 250–253, then full no-prune sync with hooks. Verify ledger 250–253 and the expected immutable running digests.
2. Execute the exact migration251 append-only terminalization function once, with its fail-closed five-work preflight, and verify five failed terminal events plus truthful operations status.
3. Verify Gate R sealed receipt, draft/shadow/closed, component off, lease 17, zero exposure, one writer, backup/readiness, and the migration253 recovery-target predicate for the exact `runtime_fault_requires_recovery` state. The fault remains truthful until a newer real recovered event.
4. Finalize this PR's source/digest/UTC binding, merge, render/diff, then full no-prune sync. Confirm a full operation selector (none/empty), the single Job outcome, append-only proof/work receipts, one writer, and live state. Never blindly retry if the Job fails after a DB commit.
5. Retire the one-shot component and activation patch after the receipt, then full no-prune sync and verify Synced + Healthy. Do not prune DB/PVC.

## Focused validation
- `pytest -q tests/test_experiment_v2_direct_proof_activation.py`: 10 passed.
- `ruff check` and commit hooks passed.
- Prod and dormant Kustomize renders each contain 127 resources, zero Secrets. Prod Job is unsuspended with `off/enabled/exact experiment ID`; dormant Job is suspended with `off/off/empty ID`.
- Compared with base main: 11 proof resources added, no resources removed; only existing resource changed is the ingestor Deployment.

Post-merge restart: verdify-ingestor (one singleton Recreate rollout caused by the bounded component/ID patch).

## Known code gate before activation
The current collector emits `wetting_incident_778_disposition=False` unconditionally. Gate P guard blocks a false prerequisite. Resolve #778 with current source-bound firmware/live evidence and a narrow truthful collector disposition before finalizing this activation. Do not set a bare boolean to true or imply that a physical inspection occurred. The parent operator is handling #841 OTA or an explicitly safe unresolved disposition before any aggressive wetting proof.
title: Stage one-shot Gate P direct-proof activation for #641
